title: arnica cordifolia subsp. genuina
intro: Arnica cordifolia subsp. genuina, commonly known as Mountain Arnica or Western Mountain Arnica, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Arnica are attributed to its ability to reduce swelling, relieve muscle and joint pain, and promote tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of Arnica cordifolia subsp. genuina include sesquiterpene lactones, such as helenalin and dihydrohelenalin, which are responsible for its anti-inflammatory and analgesic effects.
